proposed.text: Per PD 1096, Rule XII, Section 1204, what are the required specifications for draft curtains and sprinkler rings at escalator openings?

options.text: 150 mm draft curtain on two sides; sprinklers within 800 mm at max 2.00 m spacing
200 mm draft curtain on all sides; sprinklers within 600 mm at max 1.80 m spacing
250 mm draft curtain on all sides; sprinklers within 500 mm at max 2.50 m spacing
200 mm draft curtain on two sides; sprinklers within 900 mm at max 1.50 m spacing

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Escalators create a continuous open path between floor levels — a chimney effect that can rapidly spread fire, smoke, and toxic gases. The draft curtain (passive) confines smoke at ceiling level while the sprinkler ring (active) provides suppression. Together they create a compartmentalization barrier without requiring a full shaft enclosure.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096, Rule XII, Sec. 1212 / RA 9514 (Fire Code)
